description: Structured-Preset response contract: the structured lane attaches a declared `responseSchema` so the model can answer with per-field values and, when it cannot determine a field, a null filename plus the ids in `missing_fields`. This entry pins the schema bytes, so `prompt_text` is kept minimal (the compiled Preset prompt has its own byte gates in preset_prompt). The field ids are deliberately NOT in alphabetical order — a schema built from a serde_json::Value (a BTreeMap) would sort them, and both the contract property order and the field order would drift.
prompt_text: Suggest a clear, human-readable filename for the attached document.
